correct_query: SELECT s.student_name FROM students AS s INNER JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_name ORDER BY COUNT(e.student_id) DESC, s.student_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant replaces COUNT(e.student_id) (guaranteed non-NULL by the INNER JOIN) with COUNT(e.course_id) (a nullable foreign key column not constrained by the join or WHERE clause), ignoring rows where course_id IS NULL.
